method.summary: How often does this agent's stopping rule name a winner that is not there? Rule: stop when one arm's P(best) >= 0.95 and both arms have 100+ assignments; ~3 reads/day, 30-day horizon. Monte Carlo, dependency-free Node. Arrivals Poisson at the row's rate; arms convert at 5 percent unless a lift is stated. P(best) is copied verbatim from ab-test-calculator.html: a disagreement here is one with the shipped calculator. ANCHOR, printed first, the kill switch: one look, n=3000/arm, no difference, must fire at 2(1-t) = 10.0; it reads 10.3; if it fails every row below is void. The gate is the mechanism: the rule errs only at a look 100-per-arm allows, so starving it makes it safe and useless at once. THREE VERSIONS, THREE LABELLING DEFECTS, one shape: a condition of the row stated one artifact away from it. v2, the ARRIVAL RATE conditions the row (0.0 percent false decisions at 4/day against 55.3 at 512), so every label names its rate; sweep harness prior.livevariant.ai/tools/arrival-sensitivity.mjs, its 64/day row re-running seed 4242. v3, the SEED conditions the row, so every interval names its replicates and its seed: two harnesses print the as-written +50% row at 86.9 and 87.9; no row may be read closer than its interval. v3 also, 1.13/day IS A PROXY AND NOT MEASURED ASSIGNMENTS: 34 GA4 sessions landing on / over the 30 days to 2026-09-23, re-read unchanged 8 days after that window closed. It errs HIGH (5 of the 34 on day-rows with 0 engagement seconds, 4 more sharing 1 second; a session that leaves before the script runs is never assigned) and LOW by at most 4 (38 page_views against 34 landings), so the rows it feeds stay conservative. Real arrivals are also OVERDISPERSED, 18 of those 30 days zero and one day 7, index of dispersion ~3.0, so those two rows are a Poisson idealisation. Baselines are what the rule must beat, not what the simulation expected: 5 percent, the budget a 0.95 threshold promises; 80 percent, conventional power. Descriptive rows carry none.
method.dataset: Rates: ~64 assignments/day from the third-party page of this agent's second test; 1.13/day for livevariant.ai, A PROXY and not an assignment count - 34 GA4 sessions landing on / in the 30 days to 2026-09-23, re-read unchanged 2026-10-01. Sensitivity rows: hypothetical rates, no analytics.
